title: Ask toward an open problem: The Riemann hypothesis
statement: Propose five candidate un-asked questions, each smaller than the open problem below and each such that its answer would bear on it. Problem OP-MATH-RH: Do all non-trivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function have real part 1/2? Each candidate must pass the Depth requirement of LEDGER.md, must not be a duplicate of ledger/INDEX.md, must not be the problem itself or a known reformulation of it, and must carry a bears_on link to OP-MATH-RH saying how its answer would bear on the problem.
